existing_tips: Portuguese uses 'ter' (not 'haver') for compound tenses: 'tinha feito' = had done. Past participles
'Se soubesse' (if I knew/had known) – 'saber' in the imperfect subjunctive for hypothetical knowledg
'Tinha acabado de' + infinitive = 'had just' done something.
